packageRules.description: Automerge is gated on CI: Renovate merges only when the branch's status checks are green, and Verify Templates scaffolds both flavors and runs their full gate on every PR. platformAutomerge is off deliberately - GitHub's native auto-merge requires branch protection with required checks, which is unavailable on this repo, so Renovate performs the merge itself after confirming status.
typescript-eslint peers typescript <6.1.0. Without this cap Renovate opens a TypeScript 7 PR every week that verify.sh correctly rejects.
Node baseline is a deliberate LTS policy decision. Renovate would push .nvmrc to the current non-LTS release.
Digest pinning is right for a generated project but wrong inside template files, where it would emit scaffolds full of SHAs that read as stale on day one.
